context: A retired exec mentors a current boss
purpose: Teach: 来訪/実業/セットアップ/省エネ/一線/下位/浮かび/帳簿

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 来訪者対応、若い頃から鍛えた。
lines.en: Visitor relations — I've been honing that craft since I was young.
lines.style: Measured, unhurried opening. Voice carries the weight of decades. Slight pause after the dash — letting the thought settle. Not boastful, simply factual.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。実業界の重鎮には、特別な配慮、必要ですね。
lines.en: Yes. The senior figures in industry do require careful handling.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment, slightly formal. Nods slightly in the voice. Careful enunciation on 「special care」. Meeting him where he stands — not deferential, attentive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 会議のセットアップ、省エネに気を配ったな、当時から。
lines.en: Meeting logistics — I've paid attention to efficiency in resource use since those early days.
lines.style: Quiet pride threaded through. The voice of someone reviewing his own history approvingly. Steady pace, no hurry. Slight warmth on 「since those early days」.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 一線級の人材、若手も下位から育てています。
lines.en: High-calibre people — we develop them from entry level up through the ranks.
lines.style: Firmer now. A statement of purpose, not boast. Clear enunciation on 「from entry level」. The voice of someone who believes in what he's built.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 問題が浮かび上がる前に、帳簿管理を徹底しろ。
lines.en: Before problems emerge — maintain meticulous records. Don't let them catch you off guard.
lines.style: Sharp close. Imperative without harshness. Each word lands with quiet authority. Slight lean forward in the delivery — this is the core instruction.
